title: Implement IPFS write back-pressure signaling
description:
Monitor IPFS write latency with an exponential moving average. If write p99 exceeds a configurable threshold (default 500ms), reduce the ingestion queue's high-water mark to 50% and emit a warning metric (ipfs_backpressure_active gauge = 1). When latency recovers below threshold, restore full queue capacity. Artifact: transit/src/peering/backpressure.rs.

Acceptance: backpressure activates when IPFS write latency is high; recovers when latency drops; gauge reflects current state; no data loss during backpressure
